title: Pit full of kids at For the Record
body: Saturday, Oct 10, 2026, we played For the Record in Beaumont with Zegovia and Psycho Jenni. It was an all-ages show, and a big crowd of young fans kept a mosh pit going for half of our hour-long set, singing the lyrics right back at us. Thanks to everyone who came out, and to Jon and the For the Record crew for having us.
